## Import



CDC dedicated cluster image cache can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cdc/dedicatedClusterImageCache:DedicatedClusterImageCache cdc_dedicated_cluster_image_cache ${dedicated_cluster_id}#${image_id}
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
